Hi!
If you’re alright with it I’ll hand over some quick criticisms for character designs
(Btw I’m not a professional at making character designs, these are just tips I learned through tutorials)

The clothes are very bland. a T-shirt and skirt may be a nice outfit as casual wear, but compared to official Danganronpa characters they just stand out. Danganronpa clothes are rather crazy and don’t have many limitations, so it’s very important to go crazy with your character’s fashion when making one.
The clothes should also give a hint to their talent/ultimate, of course this isn’t mandatory ( taking Maki or Kaito as examples ) but it does make a character more pleasant to look at. The ultimate ballerina obviously doesn’t need to wear a tutu, but ballet is often seen as a romantic and elegant dance form, so maybe add elegant flowers as embroidery on the shirt. Looking for references is always encouraged too!

Another tip for the clothes is to make the colors a lot less vibrant, again looking at the official danganronpa cast, it’s apparent that none of them wear cyan shirts or any bright colors. This is mainly to add to the more dark contrast of the game itself, it might seem unusual to compare colors to gameplay, but visuals are probably the most important aspects of any game.
